name: keenable
title: Keenable web search
description: Keenable web search for Pi: keenable_search finds web pages, and keenable_fetch reads a public page as markdown. Each call sends the query, or the page's address, to api.keenable.ai with the header X-Keenable-Title: Pi Pocket. It needs no key. An optional Keenable API key in the module's settings raises the rate limits; it stays on the server and goes only to api.keenable.ai. Results are fenced as data from the web. The module reads no other files, settings, or secrets.
